verdicts.reason: A keeps the pill wordmark at a usable size, but the 'FIZZBANG!' text, especially the '!', is jammed against the pill outline, and the 'SINCE 2026' badge nearly touches the bottom edge. It is still a centred stack rather than a layout built for the banner. B has the same crowded '!' inside a pill shrunk to about a fifth of the width, so the brand mark is weak and flanked by large empty halftone areas, and the badge text is tiny and hard to read at this size.
